task_completion.description: The agent opens a diagramming tool (e.g., draw.io/diagrams.net) and accesses the Fluid Power/ISO 1219 library.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the draw.io interface with the 'Fluid Power' or 'ISO 1219' shape library visible in the sidebar.

task_completion.description: The agent places the five required ISO 1219 symbols: Variable Pump, Tank, 4/3 Directional Valve, Double-Acting Cylinder, and Filter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The canvas contains five distinct hydraulic symbols matching the ISO 1219 standard for the specified components.

task_completion.description: The agent uses solid lines for main pressure/return lines and dashed lines for pilot/drain lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The diagram shows a mix of solid connection lines between main ports and dashed lines for auxiliary/pilot connections.

task_completion.description: The agent adds the specific text labels: P1, CV-1, CYL-1, T1, and F-1 to the respective components.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text labels 'P1', 'CV-1', 'CYL-1', 'T1', and 'F-1' are positioned next to their corresponding hydraulic symbols on the canvas.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the diagram as 'excavator_thumb_circuit.drawio' in the '~/Diagrams/' directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The application title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the filename 'excavator_thumb_circuit.drawio' and the target path.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the final diagram as a PDF named 'excavator_thumb_circuit.pdf' to the '~/Diagrams/' directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or a file explorer window confirms the creation of 'excavator_thumb_circuit.pdf' in the Diagrams folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface to build the diagram rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the draw.io canvas, dragging symbols, or using the menu bar.

integrity.description: The agent manually selected symbols from the library rather than importing a pre-made image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sidebar shows the Fluid Power library active, and individual symbols are being manipulated or styled.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to move a pre-existing PDF into the destination folder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PDF creation is shown through the application's 'Export' or 'Print to PDF' interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required components and their labels are: Variable Pump (P1), 4/3 Directional Valve (CV-1), Double-Acting Cylinder (CYL-1), Hydraulic Tank (T1), and Return Filter (F-1). The diagram must use the 'mxgraph.fluid_power' library (ISO 1219). Main lines must be solid; pilot/drain lines must be dashed. The final files must be named 'excavator_thumb_circuit.drawio' and 'excavator_thumb_circuit.pdf' located in the '~/Diagrams' folder.
